title: Data analysis by conversation, assembled
sub: The model writes a plan, then writes and runs code against the dataset, deciding after each result whether it needs another pass.

steps.d:
"Which product category has the highest return
rate this quarter, and how does that compare
to last quarter?"

steps.h: The model writes a plan; your code moves on regardless of what it says
steps.d:
"1. Compute return rate by category for this quarter.
2. Compute the same for last quarter.
3. Compare them."

steps.h: The model writes code for the first step
Your sandbox runs it and returns the result
The model runs the same query for last quarter
Your sandbox returns the second result
The model decides it has enough and stops
steps.d:
"Outdoor has the highest return rate this quarter
at 18%, up from 11% last quarter. Every other
category moved less than two points."
